why: Bank Robbery MV round 6, rap to camera: MARINE alone, a tenement alley with fire escapes, at night, on "The right and the left both witness the theft"
prompt:
A 1920s feature-film night frame on 35mm. The mask and suit are exactly as in the attached reference image; only MARINE is in the shot, his mask copied exactly from its close-up: marine-blue rib-knit wool over the whole head, no holes, a white wool ring round the face, one small rounded red felt triangle high over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Cream linen suit, two-tone shoes, black leather gloves, cuffs over the wrists, collar up. In a tenement alley of wet cobbles and iron fire escapes, MARINE is caught mid-bounce, both heels off the ground, arms flung wide, each gloved index finger pointing sideways, staring up into the lens. High on the left wall and the right, two identical old men in nightcaps lean from lit windows holding teacups, watching blankly. High angle from a first-floor fire escape, 40mm lens. One electric street lamp behind him throws a hard rim of light and a long shadow toward the lens; steam rises from a grate. 16:9.

Thanks.
